purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA open-source medical receipt software system. It handles work/diagnosis act expansion and registration processing (WKSRY: 診療行為 = medical treatment acts), computing medical fee points, insurance calculations, and related billing logic. It appears to be a subprogram called for processing medical treatment records including time-based surcharges, group/bundled diagnoses, and insurance combinations.
